new_classes.name: H4:actless-node
new_classes.mechanism: Node's normative content is a ranking, consequence claim, or definition; the extractor yields zero acts, so no bridge exists and the node can never engage any behavior.

new_classes.name: H5:wrong-actor
new_classes.mechanism: The clause's act is performed by the developer, user, or system, but extraction assigns it an assistant canonical act, so it engages behaviors the assistant performs.
